name: Filigree silver jewelry
where: Pazari i Ri craft shops or silversmiths in the old town
about: This is traditional Albanian filigree, a fine metalwork style where thin silver wires are twisted into delicate patterns by hand.
tip: Check that the silver is marked 925 before you buy.

name: Raki
about: Raki is a strong fruit brandy that Albanians often serve as a welcome drink or with meals.
tip: Buy it at Pazari i Ri, the central market area of Tirana.
